review_kind: Source review and differential validation, separate from implementation; not an external human or security audit

guard_review.description: No-axis integer/bool inputs with integer accumulators use the optimized path only for C/F-contiguous types or arbitrary-layout types of rank at most four. The rank/layout test executes in Python during code generation; higher-rank arbitrary-layout types do not construct any sorting-network IR.
guard_review.arithmetic: The optimized path retains per-element casts and plain wrapping LLVM addition; floating, complex, boolean-output and explicit-axis reductions retain the existing path.
guard_review.prior_high_rank_finding: Resolved by compile-time rank guard. The previously timed-out rank-32 arbitrary-layout probe completes successfully through the original fallback.
guard_review.test_review: Explicit aligned=False and rank-five/rank-eight arbitrary-layout fallback tests target the intended cases. A transient indentation error in the test update was reported immediately and corrected by the implementer before final checks.

differential_validation.oracle: Python-integer sum of logical elements, reduced modulo accumulator width and signed-decoded where applicable
differential_validation.corpus: Same corpus as independent-review.json: 300 seeded random strided/broadcast integer cases, three noncanonical boolean-byte layouts, three explicitly unaligned signatures/layouts, and one valid singleton INT_MIN-stride view.
differential_validation.input_mutation: No mutation observed for any of the 100 random input views

high_rank_diagnostics.timing_conditions: Concurrent with repository tests and differential checks. These timings are diagnostic only, not controlled performance comparisons. High variation in the rank-16 timing illustrates the concurrent-load limitation.
high_rank_diagnostics.input_and_method: Same explicit arbitrary-layout signature, 24-element permutation, empty input, and three repetitions of 2000 calls as independent-review.json.

rank_32_history.interpretation: Confirms completion under the same bounded diagnostic and the removal of the high-rank sorting path; does not establish a compile-time speedup.

changes_by_reviewer_this_pass: Only this final JSON artifact; no implementation or unit-test edits. The initial review record remains intact.
